															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.
																
																
															

															

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Salary Structure

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

															
																
																Basic Pay:

																
																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

																
																	Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
																
																
																
																Additional Benefits:

																
																	Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
																	Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
																	Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
																	Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.
																
																
															

															Note: The figures mentioned are indicative and can vary based on specific postings, changes in government regulations, and other factors. For the most accurate and updated information, candidates should refer to the official SSC notifications and guidelines.

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.
																
																
															

															

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Salary Structure

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

															
																
																Basic Pay:

																
																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

																
																	Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
																
																
																
																Additional Benefits:

																
																	Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
																	Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
																	Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
																	Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.
																
																
															

															

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Salary Structure

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

															
																
																Basic Pay:

																
																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

																
																	Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
																
																
																
																Additional Benefits:

																
																	Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
																	Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
																	Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
																	Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.
																
																
															

															

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Salary Structure

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

															
																
																Basic Pay:

																
																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

																
																	Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
																
																
																
																Additional Benefits:

																
																	Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
																	Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
																	Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
																	Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.

																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. 																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.
																
																
															

															

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Salary Structure

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

															
																
																Basic Pay:

																
																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

																
																	Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
																
																
																
																Additional Benefits:

																
																	Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
																	Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
																	Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
																	Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.
																
																
															

															

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Salary Structure

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

															
																
																Basic Pay:

																
																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

																
																	Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
																
																
																
																Additional Benefits:

																
																	Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
																	Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
																	Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
																	Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.
																
																
															

															

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Salary Structure

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

															
																
																Basic Pay:

																
																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

																
																	Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
																
																
																
																Additional Benefits:

																
																	Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
																	Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
																	Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
																	Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.
																
																
															

															

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Salary Structure

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

															
																
																Basic Pay:

																
																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

																
																	Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
																
																
																
																Additional Benefits:

																
																	Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
																	Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
																	Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
																	Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.
																
																
															

															

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Salary Structure

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

															
																
																Basic Pay:

																
																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

																
																	Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
																
																
																
																Additional Benefits:

																
																	Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
																	Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
																	Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
																	Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.

Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight. Medical Examination: Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post. Document Verification: Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents. Final Merit List: Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements. Training: Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables: Basic Pay and Salary Structure: Basic Pay: The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission). Grade Pay: There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances. Allowances: Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically. House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category: X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay. Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay. Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay. Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties. Gross Salary: The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors. Deductions: Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable. Additional Benefits: Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority. Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations. Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided. Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave. Grade Pay: There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances. Allowances: Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically. Gross Salary: The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. Deductions: Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable. Grade Pay: There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances. Allowances: Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically. House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category: X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay. Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay. Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay. Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties. Gross Salary: The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors. Deductions: Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable. Additional Benefits: Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority. Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations. Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided. Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave. 															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.
																
																
															

															

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Salary Structure

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

															
																
																Basic Pay:

																
																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

																
																	Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
																
																
																
																Additional Benefits:

																
																	Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
																	Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
																	Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
																	Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.
																
																
															

															Note: The figures mentioned are indicative and can vary based on specific postings, changes in government regulations, and other factors. For the most accurate and updated information, candidates should refer to the official SSC notifications and guidelines.

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Exam Pattern / Selection Process:- 

															The selection process for SSC GD Constable 2024 typically involves several stages designed to evaluate the candidates' suitability for the role. Here's a detailed overview of the selection process:

															
																
																Online Application:

																
																	Candidates need to fill out the online application form on the SSC official website during the application window. The form usually includes personal details, educational qualifications, and other relevant information.
																
																
																
																Written Examination:

																
																	Paper-I:

																	
																		Mode: Computer-based test (CBT).
																		Duration: 90 minutes.
																		Questions: 100 objective-type questions.
																		Sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English/Hindi.
																		Marks: Each question typically carries one mark.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST):

																
																	Physical Efficiency Test (PET):

																	
																		Male Candidates:

																		
																			5 km race to be completed in 24 minutes.
																		
																		
																		Female Candidates:
																		
																			1.6 km race to be completed in 8.5 minutes.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																	Physical Standard Test (PST):
																	
																		Measurements are taken to verify that candidates meet the physical standards required for the role. Standards include height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and weight.
																	
																	
																
																
																
																Medical Examination:

																
																	Candidates who qualify the PET/PST are subjected to a detailed medical examination to ensure they meet the medical standards set by SSC for the GD Constable post.
																
																
																
																Document Verification:

																
																	Candidates must provide original documents and certificates for verification. This includes educational certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents.
																
																
																
																Final Merit List:

																
																	Based on the performance in the written examination, PET/PST, medical examination, and document verification, a final merit list is prepared. This list is based on the overall performance and the candidates’ compliance with all requirements.
																
																
																
																Training:

																
																	Finally, selected candidates are called for training, where they undergo a training program as per the requirements of the Constable GD role.
																
																
															

															

															SSC Constable GD 2024 Salary Structure

															The salary structure for SSC GD Constable positions in 2024 typically includes various components. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the salary structure for SSC GD Constables:

															Basic Pay and Salary Structure:

															
																
																Basic Pay:

																
																	The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
																
																
																
																Grade Pay:

																
																	There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
																
																
																
																Allowances:

																
																	Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.
																	House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
																	
																	
																	Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.
																
																
																
																Gross Salary:

																
																	The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
																
																
																
																Deductions:

																
																	Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
																
																
																
																Additional Benefits:

																
																	Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
																	Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
																	Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
																	Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.
																
																
															

															Note: The figures mentioned are indicative and can vary based on specific postings, changes in government regulations, and other factors. For the most accurate and updated information, candidates should refer to the official SSC notifications and guidelines.
